note: Limits for the nightly long runs (tools/long_run_check.gd). Measured with the autopilot at the commit that added them: a save is about 13 KB after 10 generations and 42 KB after 100, loading takes under 10 ms, a generation takes 0.7 to 1.6 s of play and the journal stops at 300 lines. The limits leave room for a slower, noisier machine; size and carrying on are exact, times are generous.
